sign_resync: 簽署交易或手動重新同步錢包
double_check_address: 確認該地址是否與您的 SSP 錢包地址相同.
verify_words_heading_key: Verify this matches your SSP Wallet
verify_words_body_key: Scan your SSP Wallet to verify, or check it shows these SAME 6 words. If they differ, your connection may be compromised — do not use this pairing.
verify_scan_match: Verified — your devices match, safe to continue
verify_scan_mismatch: MISMATCH — do NOT use this pairing, re-pair
wallet_address_desc: 這是您的錢包地址.您可以與任何人分享此地址以接收資金.
wallet_redeem_script_desc: 兌換腳本代碼描述了必須滿足的條件才能使用您的錢包資金.通常您不會需要這個代碼，但最好將它保存在某個地方，以防萬一需要使用.這是安全的，可以分享，不會授予對您的資金控制權，但會暴露公共金鑰.
wallet_witness_script_desc: 見證腳本代碼描述了必須滿足的條件才能使用您的錢包資金.通常您不會需要這個代碼，但最好將它保存在某個地方，以防萬一需要使用.這是安全的，可以分享，不會授予對您的資金控制權，但會暴露公共金鑰.
wallet_priv_key_desc: 私鑰授予對您特定錢包地址的控制權.這是私人部分，切勿分享，因為它授予對資金的訪問權限.
ssp_key_mnemonic_desc: 助記詞是您錢包中最重要的部分.它用於衍生所有擴展的私有和公共金鑰.請將其寫下並妥善保管.如果您丟失助記詞，將無法訪問您的資金.切勿與任何人分享，因為它授予對 SSP 金鑰部分的完全控制權.
chain_xpub_desc: 擴展公共金鑰用於衍生所有您的 {{chain}} 公共金鑰，這些金鑰用於構建地址.這是公共部分，可以分享，並不授予對資金的訪問權限.
chain_xpriv_desc: 擴展私有金鑰用於衍生所有您的 {{chain}} 私有金鑰，這些金鑰控制您的公共金鑰——地址.這是私有部分，切勿分享，因為它授予對資金的訪問權限.
err_relay_unreachable: Could not reach SSP Relay. Check your connection, or use Scan Code instead.
err_refresh_failed: Could not check for pending requests. Try again.
err_relay_auth_unavailable: Relay authentication unavailable. Nothing was sent. Make sure SSP Key is synced with SSP Wallet, then try again.
warn_tx_sent_notify_failed: Transaction sent to the network, but SSP Wallet could not be notified. It will detect the transaction on its own shortly.
err_sync_with_ssp_needed: 需要與 SSP 錢包同步.
sync_qr_needed: 請掃描 QR 代碼以先同步您的 SSP 金鑰.
dont_have_ssp_wallet: Don't have SSP Wallet? Tap here for a guide.
err_tx_decode: 解碼交易時出錯.已拒絕.
ssp_sync_request: SSP 錢包希望連接並同步 {{chain}} ({{symbol}}) 鏈到您的 SSP 金鑰.
ssp_key_info: SSP Key is the second signature for your SSP Wallet.
manual_input_info: 輸入您的交易以簽署或同步您的錢包 xpub.
ssp_help_about: SSP Key is the second signature for your SSP Wallet.
scan_camera_needed: SSP 金鑰需要訪問您的相機以掃描 QR 代碼.
err_camera_forbidden: 相機訪問被禁止.請先在手機應用權限設置中啟用它.
auth_sensitive_information: Grant access to view sensitive SSP Key information.
auth_confirm_sync: 確認與 SSP 金鑰同步 SSP 錢包
auth_confirm_public_nonces: 確認與 SSP 錢包同步公開 Nonces
auth_confirm_evm_signing: Confirm to sign EVM Chain Data.
err_auth_pw_check: 檢查密碼時出錯.請稍後再試.
auth_sign_tx: 您即將簽署並發送交易！
auth_sync_ssp: 您即將與 SSP 金鑰同步 SSP 錢包！
auth_sync_pub_nonces: 您即將與 SSP 錢包同步公開 Nonces！
auth_sync_evm_signing: You are about to sign EVM Chain Data with SSP Key! Be careful as this action may be requested by a dApp.
auth_sync_wk_signing: You are about to approve an authentication request with SSP Key! Be careful as this action may be requested by a website.
auth_delete_ssp_key_data: You are about to delete all your SSP Key Data! You will need to set up your SSP Key again or restore it from your seed phrase. Make sure you have saved your seed phrase before proceeding. This action is destructive and irreversible!
auth_recovery_info: You are about to release your wallet recovery key to a new browser environment!
auth_confirm_flux_node_start: Confirm to sign Flux node start transaction.
auth_flux_node_start_info: You are about to sign a Flux node start transaction!
auth_grant_access_pw: 使用密碼授予訪問權限.
chain_not_synced_scan: Chain not Synced with SSP Wallet. Scan SSP Wallet QR Code to Sync it.
chainsync_info_msg: Your SSP Key will share its public keys for these chains with your SSP Wallet. No funds move, and every future transaction still needs your approval on this device.
chainsync_success: Chains activated and synced with SSP Wallet.
ssp_public_nonces_request: SSP 錢包希望請求公開 Nonces。公開 Nonces 用於構建使用 Schnorr 簽名的區塊鏈交易.
ssp_recovery_request: SSP Wallet is asking to recover its encryption key after a browser change. Approve to unlock your wallet on this new browser environment.
ssp_recovery_request_warning: Only approve if you initiated this from your SSP Wallet.
recovery_verify_heading: Check these words match SSP Wallet
recovery_verify_body: SSP Wallet shows the same six words while it waits. If they differ, reject this request.
recovery_request_approved_info: Recovery response sent to your SSP Wallet.
err_recovery_failed: Could not approve the recovery request. Start it again from your SSP Wallet.
public_nonces_request_approved_info: 公開 Nonces 已生成並發送以與 SSP 錢包同步.
evm_signing_request_info: SSP Wallet would like to sign EVM Chain Data. This action may be requested by a dApp.
evm_sign_unrecognized: This request could not be fully decoded. Review the raw data and only approve if you trust the requesting site.
evm_signing_request_approved_info: EVM Signing Request was approved and sent back to your SSP Wallet.
err_sharing_public_nonces: 共享公開 Nonces 時出錯.
err_generating_public_nonces: 生成公開 Nonces 時出錯
privacy_mode_desc: Mask wallet identities and transaction references shown in the signing history. Details inside signing requests are never masked — you must always see exactly what you are approving.
err_auth_biometrics_pw_needed: Biometrics restricted, use password authentication instead.
sensitive_data_warning: WARNING: For security reasons, the {{sensitive_data}} is displayed in 2 parts. Please join them together to get the full {{sensitive_data}}. It is highly discouraged to copy the {{sensitive_data}} into your clipboard, any application or website has access to clipboard and can see your {{sensitive_data}}. Remember to delete the {{sensitive_data}} from your clipboard after copying!
delete_ssp_key_data_desc: WARNING: This will delete all data associated with your SSP Key including your seed phrase from the device. This action is irreversible!
warning_chain_only: WARNING: This address is for the {{chain_name}} ({{chain_symbol}}) blockchain only. Only deposit assets on the {{chain_name}} ({{chain_symbol}}) chain to this address. Depositing from another chain will result in a loss of funds!
wk_signing_request_info: A website is requesting your signature to authenticate. Please review the details below.
vault_xpub_request_info: Vault '{{vaultName}}' in {{orgName}} is requesting your public key.
auth_confirm_vault_xpub: Confirm to share vault public key.
auth_confirm_vault_xpub_info: You are about to share your public key for an enterprise vault. This public key will be used to derive multisig addresses for the vault.
err_vault_xpub_failed: Failed to share vault public key. Try again.
vault_sign_request_info: An enterprise vault is requesting your signature on a transaction. Please review the details below.
vault_sign_decoded_notice: Data below is decoded directly from the raw transaction you are signing. Always verify recipients and amounts before approving.
vault_sign_decode_error: Could not fully decode transaction data. Proceed with caution.
vault_sign_partial_note: Multisig vault transaction. It will only be broadcast once all required signers have approved.
vault_sign_sol_decode_mismatch: The raw transaction bytes do NOT match the displayed details. This may be an attack. Approval is blocked.
vault_sign_sol_undecodable: This device could not independently verify the transaction bytes. Amounts shown come from the relay and are NOT verified.
vault_sign_sol_approve_only: On-chain approval — recipients and amounts shown are from the proposal record, verified at creation. This signature only approves the existing on-chain proposal.
vault_sign_unverified_token: Unverified token: this device does not know this token. Check the token contract before approving.
vault_sign_message_unsupported: Message signing is only supported for EVM vaults. Approval is blocked.
vault_sim_reverted_desc: Simulation indicates this transaction reverts. Signing it could waste the fee or consume a nonce.
vault_sim_unavailable: Risk simulation unavailable. Review recipients and amounts carefully before approving.
vault_sim_warn_UNLIMITED_APPROVAL: Unlimited token approval — grants unbounded spend rights.
vault_sim_warn_NON_ZERO_APPROVAL: Token spend approval to a non-allowlisted spender.
vault_sim_warn_APPROVAL_TO_EOA: Approving a wallet address (not a contract) — almost always a scam.
vault_sim_warn_RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWLISTED: Recipient is not in your contacts or allowlist.
vault_sim_warn_ADDRESS_POISONING: Recipient looks like a known address but is not — possible address poisoning.
vault_sim_warn_NEW_RECIPIENT: This vault has never sent to this address before.
vault_sim_warn_NEW_CONTRACT: Destination contract was deployed very recently.
vault_sim_warn_VALUE_TO_CONTRACT: Sending native value to a contract.
vault_sim_warn_KNOWN_MALICIOUS: Destination flagged as malicious by a risk provider.
vault_sim_warn_SIMULATION_REVERTED: Transaction reverts in simulation — it will fail on-chain.
vault_sim_warn_BALANCE_MISMATCH: Simulated outflow does not match the stated recipients/amounts.
vault_sim_warn_SIMULATION_DECODE_MISMATC: Risk preview disagrees with the decoded transaction. Trust the decoded details above.
vault_sim_warn_SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE: Could not simulate this transaction; preview is best-effort.
auth_confirm_vault_signing_info: You are about to sign an enterprise vault transaction with SSP Key. Review the transaction details carefully.
auth_confirm_nonce_sync_info: You are about to regenerate and sync enterprise signing nonces. This will replace all existing nonces.
err_vault_sign_failed: Failed to sign vault transaction. Try again.
err_vault_sign_mismatch: Signing blocked: the transaction does not match what was shown for approval. Do not retry — contact support.
err_vault_sign_unverifiable: Signing blocked: this request could not be independently verified on your device.
err_vault_request_invalid: Request refused: it does not name a valid enterprise organisation, vault or address on this device.
err_vault_request_changed: The request changed while you were approving it. Nothing was signed. Review the request on screen before approving again.
err_vault_sign_not_member: Signing blocked: this device's key is not a member of the vault in this transaction.
err_vault_nonce_already_used: Signing blocked: this device already signed with this nonce. Sync nonces and recreate the proposal.
err_vault_nonce_persist_failed: Signing aborted: the used nonce could not be saved on this device. Nothing was sent.
err_vault_descriptor_missing: Update required: vault descriptor missing. Update SSP Enterprise and SSP Wallet, then try again. Nothing was signed.
err_vault_descriptor_changed: Refused: the configuration of this vault changed since you confirmed it on this device. Nothing was signed. If the change is expected, reset the vault pin in Settings and confirm the vault again.
err_vault_descriptor_unconfirmed: Refused: confirm this vault's signers on this device before signing. Nothing was signed.
err_vault_descriptor_invalid: Signing blocked: this request does not match a vault this device could verify
vault_descriptor_missing_info: This request does not say which vault it belongs to, so this device cannot verify it. Update SSP Enterprise and SSP Wallet. Approval is blocked.
vault_descriptor_changed_info: This request names a different set of signers than the one you confirmed for this vault on this device. It is refused. If the change is expected, reset the vault pin in Settings and confirm the vault again.
vault_pin_info: This is the first request from this vault on this device. Check its signers before you continue.
vault_pin_note: Confirm this matches the vault in SSP Enterprise. Future requests for this vault must match exactly.
vault_pin_vault_name: Vault name (as named by SSP Enterprise)
vault_pin_mode_dual: SSP Wallet and SSP Key of every signer
vault_pin_mode_sol_dual: SSP Wallet and SSP Key of every signer
vault_pin_tap_full: Tap a signer to show its full identity.
vault_pins_info: Vaults you confirmed on this device. Every request for a pinned vault must name exactly the signers you confirmed.
vault_pins_empty: No vault is pinned on this device yet.
vault_pins_reset_confirm: The next request for this vault will ask you to confirm its signers again. Only reset a pin when you know the vault configuration changed in SSP Enterprise.
vault_pins_unreadable: The vault pins on this device cannot be read. Vault requests are refused until you reset them.
vault_pins_reset_all_confirm: Every vault will ask you to confirm its signers again on its next request.
enterprise_nonce_sync_request_info: SSP Wallet is requesting to synchronise enterprise signing nonces. This will generate fresh nonces for vault transaction signing. No funds will be moved.
flux_node_start_info: SSP Wallet is requesting to sign a Flux node start transaction. Please review the details below.
flux_node_start_success: Flux node start transaction signed successfully.
err_flux_node_missing_params: Missing required parameters for flux node start.
a11y_slide_hint: Slide right to approve. With a screen reader, double tap to approve.
action_increase_allowance_raw: Increase spending allowance by {{amount}} token units
action_approval_for_all: Grant control of ALL tokens in this collection
risk_unlimited_spender: Grants {{spender}} the right to spend an unlimited amount of this token.
risk_revoked_approval: Revokes {{spender}}'s permission to spend this token.
risk_approval_for_all: Collection-wide approval — grants control of ALL tokens.
risk_approval_for_all_operator: {{operator}} will be able to transfer every token you own in this contract.
action_transfer_from_raw: Move {{amount}} token units from another address
risk_unreadable_contract_call: This transaction calls a contract this device can't fully read. Review the raw data under Advanced before approving.
tx_decode_failed_desc: Your SSP Key couldn't read this transaction, so it can't show you what it would do. To keep your funds safe it can't be approved. Reject it and try again from your SSP Wallet.
backup_checkup_body: It's been a while — confirm your SSP Key seed words still match your backup. No one can recover them for you.
backup_checkup_verify_lead: Confirm you still have your SSP Key seed words. No one can recover them for you.
backup_checkup_verify_decrypt_error: Couldn't unlock your seed words. Please try again.
backup_checkup_verified_toast: Backup confirmed — your SSP Key seed is safe.
warn_multi_recipient: This transaction pays multiple destinations. The amount shown is the total across all of them; the address shown is the first. Only approve if you expect a multi-output transaction.
warn_multi_recipient_listed: This transaction pays {{count}} destinations. The amount above is their total; every destination is listed below. Only approve if you expect each of them.
risk_contract_call_value_desc: This is not a plain transfer: it runs contract code with your funds attached. Only approve if you trust the requesting site.
risk_unverified_token_desc: This token is not in your SSP Key's token list, so the amount is shown in raw token units. Check the token address before approving.
risk_spl_owner_unverified_desc: Your SSP Wallet did not say who owns the receiving token account, so SSP Key can't confirm the recipient. Only approve if you recognise this token account.
unknown_token_units: Send {{amount}} units of an unknown token
evm_sign_refused_desc: SSP Key co-signs plain-text messages and EIP-712 typed data for this network. This request is in another format or for another network, so it can't be approved. Reject it.
evm_typed_data_warning_desc: This is not a plain message. dApps use typed data for token approvals (permits), trades and marketplace orders, and a signed approval can let someone else move your tokens without asking you again. Only sign on sites you trust, and check every field.
evm_typed_data_approval_warning: This is a token approval (permit). Signing it lets the spender move tokens from this address without another confirmation.
evm_typed_data_order_warning: This is a trade or marketplace order. Once signed, it can be filled and assets can leave this address.
evm_typed_data_acknowledge: I understand that this signature can authorise spending from this address.
wk_refused_info: This message is not a valid SSP sign-in or critical-action request, so SSP Key will not sign it. If you did not expect this request, check your SSP Wallet browser extension.
err_wk_request_refused: SSP Key refused a signing request: it was not signed by your paired SSP Wallet or is not a valid sign-in request.
wk_login_check_msg: Only approve if you are signing in to SSP Enterprise yourself, right now, at exactly this address. Never approve a sign-in you did not start.
wk_critical_origin_legacy: Not bound to a website (older request format)
wk_critical_warning_title: Approve only if you started this action
wk_critical_warning_msg: Your SSP Key signature authorises this action for your organisation. It cannot be undone once approved.
wk_critical_action_transfer_ownership_ef: Ownership of the organisation moves to the target identity. You lose your owner rights.
wk_critical_action_delete_organization_e: The organisation is deleted for every member.
wk_critical_action_remove_member_effect: The target identity is removed from the organisation.
wk_critical_action_change_enterprise_ema: The email address used to sign in to SSP Enterprise with this identity changes.
wk_requester_claimed: Claimed by the requesting site (not verified)
wk_generic_warning_msg: This signature proves control of your SSP identity to whoever receives it. Only approve if you started this sign-in yourself, on the site named in the message.
repair_info: This request would replace the SSP Wallet pairing already stored on this SSP Key for: {{symbols}}.
repair_warning_title: Only continue if you are re-pairing on purpose
repair_warning_msg: Continue only if you reset or re-created SSP Wallet and started this pairing yourself. If you did not, cancel: someone may be trying to attach a different wallet to your SSP Key.
repair_words_heading: Verification code of the new pairing
repair_words_body: After you confirm, SSP Wallet must show exactly these 6 words. If it shows different words, do not use this pairing.
err_auth_locked: Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
wk_critical_action_promote_to_admin_effe: The target identity gets admin rights over the organisation.
wk_critical_action_demote_from_admin_eff: The target identity loses its admin rights in the organisation.
wk_critical_action_remove_enterprise_ema: Email sign-in to SSP Enterprise is removed from this identity.
wk_critical_action_archive_vault_effect: The vault is archived for every member.
wk_critical_action_unarchive_vault_effec: The archived vault becomes active again.
wk_critical_action_freeze_vault_effect: No transaction can be proposed or signed from this vault until it is unfrozen.
wk_critical_action_unfreeze_vault_effect: Transactions from this vault are allowed again.
wk_critical_action_promote_vault_admin_e: The target identity gets admin rights over this vault.
wk_critical_action_demote_vault_admin_ef: The target identity loses its admin rights over this vault.
